$comment: Module Federation remotes this app consumes at runtime (see #55). Not part of bos.config.json: the bos config resolver only passes through a fixed set of known top-level keys (app, plugins, ci, ...) and silently drops anything else, so a custom 'remotes' key there never survives into .bos/bos.resolved-config.json. Read directly by rsbuild.config.ts instead, the same way it already reads bos.config.json off disk.

components.$comment: nearbuilders.org's UI Module Federation remote (name: 'ui'), exposing './components' — the design-system barrel this app will federate in (see #56/#57). 'development' assumes nearbuilders.org's own UI dev server is running locally; see the COMPONENTS_REMOTE_DEV_URL port-collision note in rsbuild.config.ts. 'production' and 'integrity' are nearbuilders.org's live custom domain and the SRI hash of its current remoteEntry.js (recompute with `computeSriHashForUrl` from everything-dev/integrity on every redeploy over there until #260 gives this a recorded, publish-time value like app.ui.integrity gets for this app's own UI).
